name: project-m
description: Local-first shared memory layer and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude, Antigravity, and Codex. This binding covers direct project-m executable launches (e.g., via uv tool install or pip); repository setups running through uv wrapper commands are outside this direct-command binding. Off until you turn it on
saferAlternatives: Keep update_task and record_decision on Review: these modify the shared SQLite blackboard and decision ledger.

Read-only tools like get_recent_context, get_turn, get_project_summary, and search_historical_context inherit standard execution; get_project_board is on Review because it synchronizes other agents' transcripts into the shared board.
